purpose: S1 source-only posthoc recorded-prediction diagnosis; not selection or causality

definitions.primary: unchanged three-source equal arithmetic macro 4+ unique Q95
definitions.paired_delta: candidate minus reference absolute official log error; below zero is improvement
definitions.tail: each per-db/per-bucket Q95 threshold, all ties included; A fixed tail is shared by B/C/D
definitions.sparse: n<200 counts only; cell Q99 only if n>=1000
definitions.pg: reference log in FP64; actual model PG input FP32 cast then promoted to FP64
definitions.directory_trust: User-owned frozen input/output directories must not be modified concurrently; hash checks detect ordinary changes, not malicious same-privilege directory substitution
definitions.limitations: one training seed, posthoc group analysis, no confidence interval or causal attribution; no model/threshold selection
